questions.stem: What is the volume of a cuboid with length $8\text{ cm}$, width $5\text{ cm}$, and height $3\text{ cm}$?
questions.explanation: Volume of a cuboid $= l \times w \times h = 8 \times 5 \times 3 = 120\text{ cm}^3$.

questions.stem: The volume of any prism is calculated by:

options.text: Multiplying the surface area by the height
Multiplying the cross-sectional area by the length
Multiplying the perimeter by the length

questions.explanation: Volume of a prism $= \text{cross-sectional area} \times \text{length}$. The cross-section is the uniform shape along the length of the prism.

questions.stem: A triangular prism has a cross-section with base $6\text{ cm}$ and height $4\text{ cm}$. The prism is $10\text{ cm}$ long. What is its volume?
